messages:
Priya: Heads-up — competitor launched a lightweight multi-tenant routing play that filters noisy tenant signals and exposes per-tenant cost caps. Sales flagged this as a pilot ask. Quick triage: do we chase exact parity or propose a differentiated 'signal-filtering' stopgap that meets the pilot?
Alex: Agree we should triage. What is the expected customer impact / ARR if we don't move? Any stopgap we can sell quickly? :thinking_face:
Maya: Sales notes from the pilot: 1) tenant-level routing profiles, 2) tenant filters on signal types, 3) flat tenant cost cap. Pilot wants p95 <100ms. We can deliver (2) + (3) by config flags and dashboard work; (1) requires runtime routing refactor.
Rick: Copying the competitor verbatim is a big lift and delays everything. Proposal: ship a 'signal-filtering' feature (tenant filter rules + cost guardrails + UI toggle) as the near-term deliverable, defer full routing profiles to next quarter. Launch criteria: p95 <100ms for pilot tenants, dashboard visibility, SDK knobs. Rollout can be gated to 5 pilot tenants.
Priya: Sounds pragmatic. @eng-bot can you spin up a quick spike ticket and ETA? We need an engineering estimate before committing to the sales promise.
eng-bot: Created RF-4313 — spike: tenant-filtering-prototype. ETA: 2w. Notes: depends on svc-rules v2 + small UI work in console. CI: add perf job for tenant-filter paths.
Alex: From commercial: if we don't match their exact phrasing, sales wants bridge language. Suggest messaging: "pilot-ready tenant signal filtering + cost guardrails" and commit to a timeline for routing profiles (8 weeks). Is that acceptable to eng?
Maya: Acceptable if we include measurable launch acceptance: docs + SDK knobs + dashboard heatmap + performance tests (p95 <100ms) + unit cost delta <5% for pilot. Also need acceptance tests simulating mixed tenant load.
Priya: Decision outline: 1) Ship tenant-level signal filters + cost caps as near-term scope; 2) Defer tenant routing profiles to next quarter but publish an 8-week roadmap commitment; 3) Rollout to 5 pilot tenants with opt-in toggle and rollback plan. Any objections?
Rick: No objections. Add rollback: default-off, per-tenant toggle, fallback to global routing if rule parsing fails. Also tag infra for capacity bump during pilot.
Alex: I'll craft the customer-facing pilot offer and a short FAQ for sales. Priya — can you add the updated scope + launch criteria to the roadmap board and ping CS?
Priya: Will do. I'll also schedule a 15-min sync with Sales and Eng next Tue.
Maya: Quick config example for the spike:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-co",
  "filters": [{"signal":"embeddings","threshold":0.7}],
  "cost_cap_usd": 500
}
```
Priya: Nice. Thanks everyone — moving to action items: RF-4313 (eng spike), sales messaging draft, roadmap update, and pilot onboarding checklist. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
